async def act(page):
    # Click on the Products link within the Catalog dropdown menu to navigate to products page
    products_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Catalog').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Products')
    await products_link.click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
